1580-4871-5670-7192.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
1580-4871-5670-7192.description:

When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Grave Venerations and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.

Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reyhan and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reyhan trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 4.

Resolve the Atog ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Repeat.

Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Transplant Theorist trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.

348-1152-2301-2992-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-1152-2301-2992-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Living Lightning from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.

When Living Lightning dies, it and Abzan Ascendancy triggers.
Resolve the Living Lightning trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 4.

Resolve the Yahenni ability
Repeat.

997-1475-7084.notablePrerequisites: You control another nonland creature with power 1 or greater that does not have One with the Kami attached to it.

Resolve the land's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the One with the Kami trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the land's power.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

Ob Nixilis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, and exiling Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library with the ability to cast it from exile until your end step.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {1}.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability trigger. dealing 1 damage to each opponent.

Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat from step 2.

803-2366-2511-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.

Repeat from step 3.

56-792-4976-5256.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

Repeat.

When Nether Traitor enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

Holding priority, activate the land played in step 1 by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Omnath's first ability triggers, creating a 5/5 Elemental creature token.
Repeat from step 5.

You have at least four devotion to any color.
You control a nontoken noncreature artifact with mana value less than or equal to the largest amount of devotion to a color you have minus four.
